"""Independent saved-array/JSON verifier. No project, MuJoCo, FK or solver imports."""
import gzip,hashlib,json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
ROOT=Path('/Users/nilakarthikesan/.codex/worktrees/partner-simulation-review/grasp-failure-prediction')
BASE=ROOT/'research_artifacts/hug_full_field_mapping_repair_2026-10-15_v2'
OUT=BASE/'run_v1'
FREEZE='f4a616c8aa7f7e5a011c5e45439e7d769f089aff'

def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def read(p):
 p=Path(p);return json.loads(gzip.decompress(p.read_bytes()) if p.suffix=='.gz' else p.read_bytes())
def arrays(p):
 with np.load(p,allow_pickle=False) as z:return {k:z[k].copy() for k in z.files}
def expect(c,message):
 if not c:raise AssertionError(message)
def clas(d,r):
 d=np.asarray(d,float);r=np.asarray(r,float)
 expect(d.ndim==2 and d.shape[1]==6 and r.shape==(len(d),),'field shape')
 expect(np.isfinite(d).all() and np.isfinite(r).all() and np.all(d>=0) and np.all(r>=0),'field finite/nonnegative')
 error=r[:,None,None]+1e-8;bands=np.asarray([1,2,5])[None,None,:]/1000.
 lower=np.maximum(0.,d[:,:,None]-error);upper=d[:,:,None]+error
 near=upper<=bands;far=lower>bands
 return dict(near=near,far=far,ambiguous=~(near|far))
def masks(native,mapped,r):
 n,m=clas(native,r),clas(mapped,r)
 required=n['near']|n['far'];preserved=(n['near']&m['near'])|(n['far']&m['far'])
 lost=n['near']&m['far'];added=n['far']&m['near']
 return dict(native_near=n['near'],native_far=n['far'],native_ambiguous=n['ambiguous'],required=required,preserved=preserved,
             definite_lost=lost,definite_added=added,unresolved_required=required&~preserved&~(lost|added))
def orientation_protected(a,b):return bool(np.all(~a['orientation_valid']|b['orientation_valid']) and np.all(~a['orientation_passed']|b['orientation_passed']))
def protection(a,b):
 lost=a['preserved']&~b['preserved'];new=(b['definite_lost']|b['definite_added'])&~(a['definite_lost']|a['definite_added'])
 ori=orientation_protected(a,b)
 return dict(passed=bool(not lost.any() and not new.any() and ori),lost_baseline_passing=int(lost.sum()),new_definite_violations=int(new.sum()),orientation_protected=ori)
def rank(a):return [int((a['required']&~a['preserved']).sum()),int((a['definite_lost']|a['definite_added']).sum()),float(max(0.,-a['margin_m'][a['required']].min(initial=0.))/.001)]

def verify_state(state,caps,limits):
 errors=np.asarray(state['tip_errors_world_m']);norms=np.sqrt(np.einsum('ij,ij->i',errors,errors,optimize=False))
 expect(np.array_equal(norms,state['tip_error_norms_m']),'serialized norms do not follow serialized errors')
 expect(np.array_equal(caps,state['original_tip_caps_m']),'caps changed')
 passes=norms<=caps;mean=bool(norms.mean()<=.010)
 expect(np.array_equal(passes,state['literal_tip_caps_pass']),'literal fingertip pass flags')
 expect(mean==state['mean_tip_guard_pass'],'mean fingertip flag')
 q=dict(zip(state['joint_names'],state['joint_qpos_rad'],strict=True))
 qpass=all(row['source_limits_rad'][0]<=q[row['joint_name']]<=row['source_limits_rad'][1] for row in limits)
 expect(qpass==state['physical_joint_limits_pass'],'literal source joint limit flag')
 return dict(norms_m=norms.tolist(),cap_minus_norm_m=(caps-norms).tolist(),individual_pass=passes.tolist(),mean_m=float(norms.mean()),mean_pass=mean,
             physical_joint_limits_pass=qpass,serialized_engineering_domain_pass=state['engineering_domain_pass'],all_literal_tips_pass=bool(passes.all() and mean))

def case(index):
 p=read(BASE/'protocol.json');old=read(p['v1_protocol']);plan=next(c for c in old['cases'] if c['source_inventory_index']==index)
 original=plan['poses'][0];grid=plan['grids'][0]
 cap_report=read(original['historical_cap_report']);caps=np.asarray(cap_report['engineering_guard_independent_audit']['original_tip_caps_sqrt_einsum_m'])
 expect(np.array_equal(caps,original['historical_tip_caps_m']),'bound literal caps')
 r=read(OUT/str(index)/'result.json');fit=r['fit'];expect(r['status']=='COMPLETED_BOUNDED_STATIC_REPAIR','completion')
 expect(r['freeze_commit']==FREEZE and r['protocol_sha256']==sha(BASE/'protocol.json'),'result protocol/commit binding')
 expect(r['native_fidelity_accepted'] is False and r['production_promotion'] is False,'no mapping promotion')
 expect(fit['accepted_mapping'] is False and fit.get('full_strict_mapping_accepted',False) is False,'no mapping pass')
 expect(fit.get('full_orientation_coverage','NOT_PROVED')=='NOT_PROVED','orientation scope')
 for k in ('physics_step_attempts','inference_attempts','official_dex_retarget_attempts'):expect(r['counts'][k]==0,'forbidden call '+k)
 orientation_protocol=read(p['orientation_protocol']);saved_rows=read(p['orientation_saved_witnesses'])['orientation_rows']
 orientation_rows=[row for row in saved_rows if row['source_inventory_index']==index]
 signs=np.sign([row['row']['native_facing_compatibility'] for row in orientation_rows]);bands=np.asarray([row['band_mm']/1000. for row in orientation_rows])
 oldarr=arrays(grid['original_cache']);native=arrays(grid['native_cache']);nd=native['native_distance_by_part_m'][:,:6];radius=oldarr['cell_radius_m']
 expect(np.array_equal(oldarr['query_object_m'],native['query_object_m']),'query alignment')
 expect(len(radius)==grid['query_count'],'query denominator')
 v1base=read(Path(p['v1_protocol']).parent/'run_v1'/str(index)/f'original_{index}.json')
 limits=v1base['source_limit_rows']
 zrows=[];zs={}
 json_hashes={str((ROOT/v['array_path']).resolve()):v['array_sha256'] for v in (fit['baseline'],fit['returned'])}
 for file in sorted((OUT/str(index)).glob('*.npz')):
  digest=sha(file);z=arrays(file);zs[file.name]=z
  if str(file.resolve()) in json_hashes:expect(digest==json_hashes[str(file.resolve())],'NPZ reference hash')
  fields=masks(nd,z['distance_m'],radius)
  expect(all(np.array_equal(z[k],v) for k,v in fields.items()),'literal mask mismatch '+file.name)
  error=radius[:,None,None]+1e-8;b=np.asarray([1,2,5])[None,None,:]/1000.
  margin=np.where(fields['native_near'],b-error-z['distance_m'][:,:,None],z['distance_m'][:,:,None]-error-b)
  expect(np.array_equal(margin,z['margin_m']),'frozen search margin mismatch '+file.name)
  for k in ('distance_m','margin_m','orientation_score','orientation_distance_m'):expect(np.isfinite(z[k]).all(),'nonfinite '+k)
  expect(int(fields['required'].sum())==grid['required_relationships'],'required denominator')
  orientation_passed=((signs*z['orientation_score']-orientation_protocol['facing_dot_numerical_deadzone'])>0)&(z['orientation_distance_m']<=bands)&(z['orientation_distance_m']>orientation_protocol['query_boundary_tolerance_m'])&z['orientation_valid']
  expect(np.array_equal(orientation_passed,z['orientation_passed']),'exact retained orientation predicate')
  zrows.append(dict(path=str(file.relative_to(ROOT)),sha256=digest,hash_compared_to_result=str(file.resolve()) in json_hashes,
    counts={k:int(v.sum()) for k,v in fields.items()},rank=rank(z),all_saved_masks_recomputed_exact=True,margin_recomputed_exact=True,
    retained_orientation_predicate_recomputed_exact=True,retained_orientation_valid_count=int(z['orientation_valid'].sum()),retained_orientation_passed_count=int(z['orientation_passed'].sum())))
 baseline=zs[Path(fit['baseline']['array_path']).name];returned=zs[Path(fit['returned']['array_path']).name]
 oldv1=arrays(Path(p['v1_protocol']).parent/'run_v1'/str(index)/f'original_{index}_density2mm.npz')
 expect(np.array_equal(baseline['distance_m'],oldv1['current_distance_by_part_m']),'baseline distances reproduce v1')
 for k in masks(nd,baseline['distance_m'],radius):expect(np.array_equal(baseline[k],oldv1[k]),'baseline classification differs v1')
 current=zs[next(k for k in zs if 'restored_start' in k)];roundrows=[]
 for rr in fit['rounds']:
  candidates=[k for k in zs if f"round_{rr['round']}_candidate" in k]
  if not rr['candidate_found']:expect(not candidates,'unexpected candidate file');continue
  expect(len(candidates)==1,'one candidate checkpoint')
  candidate=zs[candidates[0]];pg=protection(baseline,candidate);cg=protection(current,candidate);cr=rank(candidate)
  expect(pg==rr['full_field_protection'] and cg==rr['current_preserved_protection'],'round protection flags')
  expect(cr==rr['candidate_rank'],'round rank')
  newly=int((candidate['preserved']&~current['preserved']).sum())
  chosen=rr['selected_feasible_search_step']
  expect(rr['newly_preserved_relationships']==(newly if chosen else 0),'newly repaired credit')
  expect(rr['accepted_relationship_repair']==bool(chosen and newly>0),'round accepted relationship flag')
  if chosen:
   expect(pg['passed'] and cg['passed'] and cr<rank(current),'selected protection/rank')
   current=candidate
  roundrows.append(dict(round=rr['round'],rank=cr,baseline_protection=pg,current_protection=cg,newly_preserved_before_admission=newly,
      selected=chosen,credited_repairs=rr['newly_preserved_relationships']))
 refused=fit['status'].startswith('REFUSED_')
 if refused:
  for k,v in baseline.items():expect(np.array_equal(v,returned[k]),'refusal must retain baseline evidence '+k)
  start_gate=protection(baseline,current)
  expect(fit['status']=='REFUSED_NO_PROTECTED_START' and not start_gate['passed'],'no-protected-start refusal')
  expect(not fit['rounds'] and not fit['activated_rows'],'refused start must stop before rounds')
 else:
  for k,v in current.items():expect(np.array_equal(v,returned[k]),'returned differs selected current '+k)
 pg=protection(baseline,returned)
 if not refused:expect(pg==fit['final_protection'],'final protection')
 repaired=int((returned['preserved']&~baseline['preserved']).sum());progressed=rank(returned)<rank(baseline)
 expectedstatus='IMPROVED_RELATIONSHIPS_DIAGNOSTIC' if repaired else 'FEASIBLE_SEARCH_PROGRESS_ONLY' if progressed else 'NO_ACCEPTED_SURFACE_IMPROVEMENT'
 if not refused:expect(fit['status']==expectedstatus,'status/rank/repaired interpretation')
 expect(fit['repaired_relationship_count']==repaired and fit['accepted_relationship_repair']==bool(repaired),'repair count')
 expect(fit['feasible_search_progress_only']==bool(progressed and not repaired),'rank-only interpretation')
 state_checks={key:verify_state(fit[key]['state'],caps,limits) for key in ('baseline','returned')}
 if not refused:expect(state_checks['returned']['all_literal_tips_pass'],'returned original tip caps')
 for key,z in (('baseline',baseline),('returned',returned)):
  v=fit[key];counts={k:int(z[k].sum()) for k in masks(nd,z['distance_m'],radius)}
  expect(counts==v['field_boolean_counts'],'JSON boolean counts')
  for name,value in counts.items():expect(v['summary'][name]==value,'summary count')
  expect(v['summary']['full_strict_mapping_status']=='FAIL' if counts['definite_lost']+counts['definite_added'] else v['summary']['full_strict_mapping_status']=='INCOMPLETE','strict status')
  for name in ('valid','passed','score','distance_m'):expect(np.array_equal(z['orientation_'+name],v['orientation'][name]),'orientation serialization '+name)
 payload=r['final_readback']['serialized_pose'];s=fit['returned']['state']
 expect(payload['joint_targets_rad']==dict(zip(s['joint_names'],s['joint_qpos_rad'],strict=True)),'serialized named q exact')
 for name in ('root_position_m','root_quaternion_wxyz'):expect(payload[name]==s[name],'serialized root exact')
 expect(r['final_readback']['full_strict_mapping_accepted'] is False,'final no PASS')
 return dict(index=index,result_sha256=sha(OUT/str(index)/'result.json'),status='VERIFIED_FROM_SAVED_ARRAYS',fit_status=fit['status'],
     checkpoints=zrows,baseline_rank=rank(baseline),returned_rank=rank(returned),repaired_relationship_count=repaired,final_protection=pg,
     state_checks=state_checks,rounds=roundrows,no_mapping_pass=True,no_task_labels=True,
     returned_is_baseline_evidence_only=refused,restored_start_protection=protection(baseline,zs[next(k for k in zs if 'restored_start' in k)]),
     limitations=['No geometry/FK replay; tip errors and eligibility checked from serialized outputs only',
                  'Intermediate NPZ hashes inventoried and rechecked for stability, but only baseline/final hashes are externally indexed in result.json'])

if __name__=='__main__':
